evidence: Matches the TX fees and policy label and modifies standardness script verification flags for mempool acceptance in src/validation.cpp.
rationale: Allows `-acceptnonstdtxn=1` nodes on testnets to admit transactions violating non-mandatory script flags into the mempool. As noted in review discussion, this provides clear value for testing soft forks and non-mandatory script rules on test networks, but it is limited to testnets and reasonably deferrable.
